## ctxloom command show

Show command content

### Synopsis

Display the content of a specific command.

Reference format: bundle#commands/name

Examples:
  ctxloom command show core#commands/code-review
  ctxloom command show go-tools#commands/testing

```
ctxloom command show <bundle>#commands/<name> [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -d, --distilled     Show distilled version
  -i, --interactive   Review effective trust and offer to trust/blacklist (interactive terminal only)
```
